data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘renascentia’, meaning ‘rebirth’. Renan represents new beginnings and renewal. in_english.long_meaning: The name Renan originates from Hebrew roots, associated with rebirth or renewal. It signifies spiritual rejuvenation and joy. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, its etymology aligns with themes of renewal found in Christian scripture. Historically, it has been used in various Christian cultures to symbolize new life in Christ. The name Renan is also linked to Saint Renan, a 5th-century Welsh saint.
